column1: # Doom Emacs leader bindings that Minga matches or deliberately diverges from.
# One row per Doom key. The key grammar test (test/minga/keymap/grammar_test.exs) checks:
# - every row with a minga_key binds that key to minga_command today;
# - a Minga leader binding on a listed doom_key is declared here by a row whose minga_key and minga_command match it, otherwise it is a :doom_conflict;
# - a top-level leader key (SPC x) is allowed only when it is listed here as a doom_key.
# "matches" means same key, same meaning. "diverges" means Minga deliberately uses the key differently, places the meaning elsewhere, or leaves it unbound ("-"), and the reason says why.
